issues.on_page: Other 758,895 (p4), of which Depreciation Fund 'Fund Transfer In' 375,000 (p10) and Employee Benefit 'Transfers In' 40,365 (p11)
issues.issue: [fixed] left as printed pending the decision_needed entry on the 415,365 one-sided transfer. 415,365 of this 'other' receipt is printed as transfers in on the Depreciation and Employee Benefit schedules (the statement's General Fund column includes those funds). A transfer has been recorded as revenue. Under the hidden-transfer rule it should be split out (split_from, review) into transfers_in, leaving about 23,588 in receipts. The detail section already records both as other financing, so receipts and detail disagree. decision_needed[0] asks the right question (one-sided transfer, no matching outflow in the General Fund schedule), but the top-level figure still counts the transfer as revenue.
